g.text: MinVelRank2Convo1 begins.
PapaPolar: so i sit down with that adorable little sugared-up squirrel, right?
Who?
Lol. Hi, Velimir.
I'm going to assume you mean Amir.
PapaPolar: do i look like some colt gisney princess to you? who do you think i mean?
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: the big-hearted zippy-de-doo-dah boy himself, amir
PapaPolar: heh, yeah. hey
PapaPolar: well i'm sure as shit no colt gisney princess so i don't mean it literally lol
PapaPolar: anyway so i'm talking to him - or rather, he's talking AT me
PapaPolar: ... which is something i get the feeling you fully understand ...
PapaPolar: 'n he starts yabbering at me about some alternate dimension you're from??
Duviri. It's complicated.
Yeah, it's a long story.
PapaPolar: i got it at about eight bajillion miles per hour, don't friggin' worry about it, pal
PapaPolar: shit. i think i followed about a third of it. and the third i got, was a third too much. you need a hug, pal?
I'm all right. Doing better since I came here, weirdly.
Just don't snap my spine when you do it, big guy.
I'll never turn down a free hug.
PapaPolar: glad you found somewhere that helped fill in the blanks. that's more than a lot of people get in life.
PapaPolar: HAH. free chiropractor visit, and now i have a built-in ice pack service
PapaPolar: good for you. life's too shit to turn down the things that make it better.
PapaPolar: home isn't where you were born, it isn't the people who raised you, it's the places and people that make you feel whole.
Check boolean MinervaVelimir1
Can I ask you what the deal is between you two and Rusalka?
true
Minerva still pissed at you?
true
false
So... Are you and Minerva... A thing?
false
PapaPolar: since she's still off being pissed at me, i suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you
PapaPolar: when isn't she...
Update boolean MinervaVelimir1
Update boolean MinervaNeci3a
PapaPolar: she has her reasons, though. trust me. i don't make it easy on her.
PapaPolar: mmm. kinda. we were married, but not really anymore. on paper only. somewhere. in some country that stopped existing circa 1982?

PapaPolar: we were overseas in a lil town a few countries south of here. place got blown to bits. found a little girl there. just a tiny thing, knee high, all red hair and pissed as a kicked hive of bees
Check boolean MinervaVelimir1
PapaPolar: does that count?
PapaPolar: she tried to stab me six times with a spoon bahahaha cutest lil thing you've ever seen.
PapaPolar: since she's still off being pissed at me, i suppose it doesn't hurt to tell you
true
PapaPolar: you can probably see it plain as day, the two of us used to be a "thing." married, actually.
false
That explains the arguing I guess.
Yeah, doesn't seem like you two are still together.
PapaPolar: had this little stuffed rabbit toy she was clinging to, though. M told her she'd protect it with her life 'n keep it safe.
Update boolean MinervaVelimir1
PapaPolar: when neci left to go join scaldra... things weren't ever the same between us. it was the last straw, i think.
PapaPolar: what gave it away.
PapaPolar: that got neci's trust real fast. ran right for M and threw her arms around her. we quit the military then. well. officially. became "consultants."
PapaPolar: but now it's just a thing on paper. and i suppose that since that country ceased to exist circa 1982, you can decide if it still counts at all anyway
PapaPolar: she took one look at scaldra and called a spade a spade. saw it for what it was. dangerous. a cult.
PapaPolar: so... we raised her as our own. think of her as our daughter, even though she isn't.
PapaPolar: and moreover, something that was gonna get our little girl killed. but... i said she wasn't a kid anymore.
PapaPolar: when neci said she wanted to join some military mercenary faction and said they really believed in something? M said no.
PapaPolar: i... gave her my blessing to leave.
PapaPolar: told M... to "have a little faith" har har...
PapaPolar: thought maybe that neci saw something in that viktor guy, maybe she'd find somebody like i found somebody...
PapaPolar: whep.
This isn't your fault.
Oh...
I'm so sorry.
PapaPolar: thanks. but i told her to get onto that sinking ship, and it sunk. minerva saw the holes. i chose to ignore them
PapaPolar: big, typical, stupid me. doing typical big, stupid me things.
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
PapaPolar: blegh. i need a cold one. gonna go throw a few back. ttyl.
PapaPolar: thanks. tried to let my little girl run free, and lost my whole family over it.
PapaPolar: but i appreciate the sentiment, i do.
+20 Chemistry
